title: Findings file
description: The claims a deep-research study asserts, each answering sub-questions and citing sources. The audit spine of 'research' mode: claim -> source.

answers.description: Sub-question ids (from brief.json) this finding addresses.

cites.description: Source ids (from sources.json) this finding rests on. Every finding cites at least one.

verification.description: unverified (gate blocks) -> corroborated (>=2 sources) | single-source (advisory) | disputed (sources conflict).
